Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Armor of Terra
Type: Action
Requires: Visceratika/Thaumaturgy
Cost: 1 blood
+1 stealth action.
[tha] Put this card on a slave Gargoyle you control. The Gargoyle with
this card treats aggravated damage as normal damage. Burn this card if
this Gargoyle goes to torpor. A Gargoyle can have only one Armor of
Terra.
[vis] As [tha] above, but put this card on this acting Gargoyle.
[VIS] As [vis] above, and the Gargoyle with this card may prevent 1
damage each combat.

If I had a Gargoyle who had an already previously played Armor of
Terra, and I wanted to play Armor of Terra at VIS (to upgrade), could
I play it and burn the previously played copy? I think not, but I
wanted to ask.

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
